title: Use Gemini Notebook with a work or school Google account - Gemini Notebook Help

facts.fact: Gemini Notebook is now a core service for Workspace and Workspace for Education users, alongside Gmail, Google Calendar, and Docs.
facts.quote: Gemini Notebook is now a core service (like Gmail, Google Calendar, and Docs).

facts.fact: Under Standard Access, each user can create up to 100 notebooks.
Under Standard Access, each notebook can hold up to 50 sources.
Under Standard Access, users get 50 chats per day.
Under Standard Access, users get 3 Audio Overviews per day.
Under Standard Access, users get 10 Reports per day, and the same 10 per day limit applies to Flashcards, Quizzes, and Mind Maps.
Under Standard Access, Deep Research is limited to 10 uses per month, while the More Access tier allows 3 per day.
Visible watermarks are applied automatically to generated images and videos for users residing in India, South Korea, or Vietnam.
facts.quote: A visible watermark will be applied automatically if you reside in India, South Korea, or Vietnam.

facts.fact: All outputs generated in Gemini Notebook using Veo, Omni, or Nano Banana include invisible SynthID watermarks.
facts.quote: All outputs generated in Gemini Notebook using Veo, Omni, or Nano Banana include invisible SynthID watermarks.

facts.fact: Under enterprise-grade security and privacy, uploaded files, chats, and model outputs are not reviewed by human reviewers or used to improve generative AI models.
facts.quote: Your uploaded files, chats and model outputs won’t be reviewed by human reviewers or used to improve generative AI models.

facts.fact: Higher limits and additional features require a Workspace plan with higher limits, and the organization must upgrade its license through the Google Workspace administrator.
facts.quote: your organization needs to upgrade to a Google Workspace plan that includes higher limits.
